The '''Kessa system''', also known as the '''Kessel system''', was a three-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] that contained the irregularly shaped planet of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. It was located near the [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] cluster known as [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].

==History==
Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hawk Carrow]] and [[Nagraoao]] were prisoners in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] took his ship, the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', to the Kessel system to rescue his friends, but was stopped by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] for inspection. Garnet bribed a Navy officer to let him go.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
